target_environment: Ubuntu 20.04, ROS Noetic, Gazebo Classic 11.15.1, gazebo_plugins 2.9.3
behavioral_changes: publishOdometry uses World::SimTime sec/nsec instead of ros::Time::now
publishWheelJointState uses the same simulation timestamp source
publishWheelTF uses the same simulation timestamp source when enabled
preserved: all SDF parameter names and defaults
all update scheduling and drive control logic
all original ROS publishers, subscribers, frames, queues and reset logic
delivery_scope: Source package only; no model edits, no launch switch, no system-library replacement.
validation_boundary: User-reported VM build, dependency/model precheck and actual library mapping passed; two independent 40-wall-second raw TF/Odom/clock windows had no duplicates/backwards stamps, including a light-preview RViz run. Long-term, reset and post-patch nonzero-motion regression are not verified. No VM binary is shipped.
